responsibility: This file implements the out-of-line construction logic for rtx_vector_builder, GCC’s helper for building CONST_VECTOR RTL constants. It finalizes pattern encoding, recognizes when a one-pattern vector can reuse globally cached all-zero/all-one/all-minus-one vector constants, materializes the full rtvec element list when needed, and handles stepped polynomial element generation for integer vector constants. Its responsibility is efficient creation and caching of RTL vector constants, complementing the generic builder logic declared in the header.
same_name_distinction: Contains the out-of-line methods of rtx_vector_builder that actually materialize CONST_VECTOR RTL objects, apply integer steps, and reuse cached all-zero/all-one/all-minus-one vectors; the header defines the builder class shape and inline hooks.
